Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728

Class McpProtectedResourceMetadata

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.McpProtectedResourceMetadata
@BeanType(propertyNamer=PropertyNamerULC.class) public class McpProtectedResourceMetadata extends Object
Server-side representation of an RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata (PRM) document, emitted by the 2026-07-28 MCP resource server from its .well-known/oauth-protected-resource endpoint so a client can discover which authorization server(s) protect this MCP server.

The property namer maps the camel-case Java properties to the snake-case wire field names RFC 9728 mandates (resource, authorization_servers, scopes_supported, bearer_methods_supported), so Juneau bean serialization produces JSON that parses cleanly on the client side via org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth.McpProtectedResourceMetadata / McpProtectedResourceMetadataClient.

Q5 client/server split:

This intentionally duplicates the shape of the client-side org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth.McpProtectedResourceMetadata record (accepted per READY-312f Q5); the two live in different modules with different dependency footprints (the client parses via Nimbus; the server emits via Juneau marshalling). Sub-project D later rationalizes a shared, dependency-neutral bean.

Since:
10.0.0
